title: Helium GKG share leads NTR returns
hypothesis: R2 | [fertilizer-ag] GDELT helium GKG share 20d z-score > 1 leads NTR log returns by 3 days (+) because Qatari helium outages co-occur with ammonia plant halts; long NTR 5d [gdelt.gkg.helium_share -> finance.NTR.log_return]
message: Weak positive r=0.085 (n=390, best lag -1d r=0.19) but long-NTR rule unprofitable: 5 trades, 20% hit, avg -0.9%, actionability 0; not tradable.

trade_idea.entry_rule: gdelt.gkg.helium_share rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long NTR next session

trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.
